video-prompt.generating.zh: Claude 正在为这张幻灯片写视频提示词…
video-prompt.generating.en: Claude is writing a video prompt for this slide…

video-prompt.copy-failed.zh: 没能自动复制。选中下面的提示词，手动复制。
video-prompt.copy-failed.en: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the prompt below and copy it.

video-prompt.failed.zh: 没能写出视频提示词，再试一次。
video-prompt.failed.en: Lumi couldn’t write the video prompt. Try again.

video-prompt.blocked.zh: 写视频提示词要用 Claude，你的 Claude API 密钥还没连上。
video-prompt.blocked.en: The video prompt needs Claude, and your Claude API key isn’t connected yet.

video-format.steps.zh: 复制提示词，在你常用的视频工具里生成视频，再点「换成视频」放到这张幻灯片上。
video-format.steps.en: Copy the prompt, make the video in any tool you like, then select Use a video to add it to this slide.

video-format.shape.zh: 画面：横屏 {ratio}，和幻灯片一样
video-format.shape.en: Shape: landscape {ratio}, same as the slides

video.too-large.zh: 视频太大了，控制在 {size} 以内。
video.too-large.en: Video too large. Keep it under {size}.

video.unsupported.zh: 这个格式放不了，换成 {formats} 再试。
video.unsupported.en: This format won’t play here. Use {formats} instead.

video.not-kept.zh: 已换成视频，但浏览器没能保存它。刷新页面后，要重新上传。
video.not-kept.en: Video added, but the browser couldn’t save it. Upload it again after you reload the page.

video.add-failed.zh: 没能换成视频。再试一次，或者换一个文件。
video.add-failed.en: Couldn’t add the video. Try again or use another file.
